title: Latest cost-of-living protests bring more than 140,000 onto the streets across France
paragraphs: Latest cost-of-living protests bring more than 140,000 onto the streets across France

Paris (France) (AFP) – Tens of thousands of people took part in protests across France on Tuesday after unions called a new nationwide public sector strike to demand pay rises. Participation was lower compared to previous demonstrations, with 146,000 people demonstrating across the country, according to the interior ministry, compared with 575,000 for the previous unified protests. Unions put Tuesday's number at 550,000.
